setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 has two patterns assigned. Pattern 1 has trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F: MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) and pattern 2 has trigs on steps 1 and 2 (note C, velocity 100). The Merge modes screen is showing at 90 BPM with every merge mode at its default and playback stopped. The Patterns row reads 01 02: it only shows which patterns the channel plays, and turning E3 on it changes nothing. Assign patterns with the pattern slot buttons on the grid.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K2, turn E1 to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Merge modes and press K3 to return to the Merge modes screen, then turn E2 down to Strategy, the trig merge. It reads SKIP, the default: a step plays only if exactly one pattern has a trig there. Steps 1 and 2 are in both patterns and drop out; only steps 3 and 4 remain.
steps.title: Skip overlap

steps.caption: Press Play at (1,8), then Stop. The loop plays only steps 3 and 4: MIDI 64 (velocity 107) and 65 (velocity 97), over and over.
steps.title: Hear Skip

steps.caption: Turn E3 up once: Strategy reads ONLY, with the footer ONLY APPLIED. (Turning E3 down first does nothing: SKIP is the lowest choice.) Only keeps steps that have a trig in more than one pattern, so steps 1 and 2 play and steps 3 and 4 drop out. The (14,8) button follows the choice.
steps.title: Keep overlap

steps.caption: Turn E3 up once more: Strategy reads ALL, footer ALL APPLIED. Every trig from either pattern plays. The change applies immediately; there is no K3 apply. The (14,8) button follows the choice.
steps.title: Play the union

steps.caption: Press Play, then Stop. All four steps sound: MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 114, 109, 107, 97. Steps 1 and 2 are in both patterns, so their notes and velocities are averaged: C and C stay C, and (127 + 100) / 2 = 114.
steps.title: Hear All

steps.caption: Turn E2 down to Note mode, the pitch merge. It reads AVERAGE, the default. The screen's labels map to the manual's modes: UP is Higher, DOWN is Lower, and PAT 1 and PAT 2 take the note from that pattern.
steps.title: Open Note mode

steps.caption: Turn E3 up one detent at a time and watch Note mode: AVERAGE, then UP (Higher), DOWN (Lower), PAT 1, and finally PAT 2. At PAT 2 each step takes its note from pattern 2, which is C everywhere. The rhythm still comes from the ALL strategy.
steps.title: Turn through the note modes

steps.caption: Press Play, then Stop. The four steps still sound, now all at MIDI 60, pattern 2's note, with the same velocities (114, 109, 107, 97).
steps.title: Hear Pattern 2 notes

steps.caption: Turn E3 down four detents: PAT 1, DOWN, UP, then AVERAGE (one more turn down stays on AVERAGE). Press Play, then Stop. The phrase is back to MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65.
steps.title: Restore the average and hear it
